title: KEHTI THI YEHI ZAINAB DUKHIYA
body:
KEHTI THI YEHI ZAINAB DUKHIYA
MERE BEERANVA MUJRA LO MERA
KUCH BAAT KAROON MAIN TUM PAH FIDA
MERE BEERANWA MUJRA LO MERA
<<DIVIDER>>
MAIN KOOKH JALI MAAJAYI HOON
HAMSHEER TUMHARI BHAI HOON
ZINDAAN SE CHUTKAR AAYI HOON
MERE BEERANWA MUJRA LO MERA
<<DIVIDER>>
NIKLI THI WATAN SE JAB MEIN AQI
TUM SAATH THAY AUR KUNBA THA SABHI
AB KOI NAHIN TANHA HOON CHALI
MERE BEERANWA MUJRA LO MERA
<<DIVIDER>>
AKBAR BHI NAHIN ABBAS NAHIN
QASIM SA BHATIJA PAAS NAHIN
AB MUJHKO KISI KI AAS NAHIN
MERE BEERANWA MUJRA LO MERA
<<DIVIDER>>
ZINDAAN MEIN GAYI DARBAR GAYI
SAR NANGAY SARE BAAZAR GAYI
BIN TERE ZALEELO QAAR GAYI
MERE BEERANWA MUJRA LO MERA
<<DIVIDER>>
POOCHEGI AGAR MUJHSE SUGHRA
HAE BAAP PHOOPI KIS JA MERA
KYA US SE KAHOON BOLO BHAIYA
MERE BEERANWA MUJRA LO MERA
